title: FPGAgent: An LLM-Assisted Framework for Autonomous HLS Code Generation and Verification in FPGA Environments
abstract: arXiv:2608.23630v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have shown substantial promise for high-level synthesis (HLS) code generation, but most existing approaches validate only simulation or synthesis results. Because of timing and place-and-route constraints, \emph{HLS code that passes simulation and synthesis may still fail to produce deployable, runnable designs on real FPGA platforms}. Moreover, the lack of public benchmarks has limited many evaluations to small, self-curated test suites. We propose FPGAgent, a multi-agent framework tailored to real FPGA environments for autonomous HLS coding with end-to-end executability validation. To the best of our knowledge, FPGAgent is \emph{the first task-specification-to-executable HLS generation framework experimentally validated on a well-established benchmark}. Given a natural-language task specification, FPGAgent injects HLS-specific knowledge and employs evolutionary search to iteratively derive reliable HLS kern

translated_title: FPGAgent：一种面向FPGA环境的LLM辅助自主HLS代码生成与验证框架
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在高层次综合（HLS）代码生成方面显示出巨大潜力，但大多数现有方法仅验证仿真或综合结果。由于时序和布局布线约束，通过仿真和综合的HLS代码在真实FPGA平台上仍可能无法生成可部署、可运行的设计。此外，缺乏公开基准导致许多评估仅限于小型自建测试集。我们提出FPGAgent，一种专为真实FPGA环境定制的多代理框架，用于自主HLS编码并具备端到端可执行性验证。据我们所知，FPGAgent是首个在成熟基准上实验验证的任务规格到可执行HLS生成框架。给定自然语言任务规格，FPGAgent注入HLS特定知识并采用进化搜索迭代推导可靠的HLS内核。
tldr: FPGAgent首次在成熟基准上实现了从自然语言任务规格到可执行HLS代码的端到端自主生成与验证，克服了现有方法忽略时序和布局布线约束的局限。
en_tdlr: FPGAgent is the first framework to achieve end-to-end autonomous generation and verification of executable HLS code from natural language task specifications on a well-established benchmark, overcoming the limitation of existing methods that ignore timing and place-and-route constraints.
